احتسبتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَبَتَا (iḥtasabatā) /iħ.ta.sa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# اُحْتُسِبَتَا (uḥtusibatā) /uħ.tu.si.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
